d: Dharampur, Jamui | In this Ground Report, Khabargaon went to the Dharampur Village of Sikandra assembly constituency in Bihar’s Jamui district. This is the same village from where atleast 187 names have allegedly been removed from the voter list. Congress MP and LoP Rahul Gandhi brought four individuals from this same village in his press conference on alleged vote theft, which he called Hydrogen Bomb.
